notes.en: Public preview 0.2.3. A refreshed layout that matches Relayium for Mac: grouped cards, a reading width on tablets, and a status panel at the top of Device Inbox and Nearby. Device Inbox adds Check now, which asks for finished deliveries immediately instead of waiting for the next check; it never interrupts a transfer in progress and never accepts anything for you. Stored downloads now resume after a dropped connection where the server allows it, the screen stays on only while a transfer is actually running, and pasting a stored-file link into Code or link opens it. Everything still runs while the app is open, with no background transfer. Direct APK only, not on Google Play, and it contains no Play Services and no Play Billing.
notes.zh: 公开预览版 0.2.3。界面与 Mac 版 Relayium 保持一致：分组卡片、平板上的阅读宽度，设备收件箱与附近设备顶部新增状态区。设备收件箱新增「立即检查」，会立即查询已上传完成的投递，而不必等下一次自动检查；它不会打断正在进行的传输，也不会替你接收任何内容。存储链接下载在服务器允许时可在断线后续传；只有在真正传输时才保持屏幕常亮；在「代码或链接」中粘贴存储文件链接即可打开。所有功能仍然只在应用打开时运行，没有后台传输。仅以 APK 直接分发，不在 Google Play 上架，不含 Play 服务与 Play 结算。
